properties.value: Dependency declaration: golang.org/x/crypto/curve25519 in go.mod — X25519 implementation available to the build; X25519 is Shor-vulnerable as a KEX primitive (used only by TLS group negotiation here).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Module records: JWT signing library references (golang-jwt) in go.sum and the ko build-tool module — dependency inventory for JWT signing.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Changeable here. Production Postgres deployment config: ssl=on with server cert+key from the pod-identity service-DNS bundle (credential-bundle.pem, minted through the localca ECDSA-P256/Ed25519 chain) and client CA from trust-bundle.pem. The handshake algorithms are whatever the Postgres build negotiates (classical ECDHE unless the build is PQ-capable).
